aiGuidance.purpose: The problem itself: one sentence or a short paragraph stating what is wrong or missing, from the point of view of the persona who holds it.
aiGuidance.extraction: State the problem, not the fix. Keep it falsifiable and specific to who is affected.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not include the remedy, facet labels or a persona name as prose; the persona is a held-by relation.
